label: CMS Outpatient Claim
description: One DE-SynPUF outpatient claim (2008-2010): the beneficiary and claim identifiers, the visit as the FHIR encounter by identifier, provider and physicians, the payment and blood deductible amounts, the Part B coinsurance and deductible, the admitting diagnosis, up to ten diagnoses, six procedures and ten HCPCS codes. Members: Beneficiary Code (DESYNPUF_ID); Claim ID (CLM_ID); Claim Line Segment (SEGMENT); encounter (FHIR); Provider Institution (PRVDR_NUM); Claim Payment Amount; Primary Payer Claim Paid Amount; Attending Physician NPI (AT_PHYSN_NPI); Operating Physician NPI (OP_PHYSN_NPI); Other Physician NPI (OT_PHYSN_NPI); Blood Deductible Liability Amount; Part B Coinsurance Amount; Part B Deductible Amount; Admitting Diagnosis; Claim Diagnosis 1; Claim Diagnosis 2; Claim Diagnosis 3; Claim Diagnosis 4; Claim Diagnosis 5; Claim Diagnosis 6; Claim Diagnosis 7; Claim Diagnosis 8; Claim Diagnosis 9; Claim Diagnosis 10; Claim Procedure 1; Claim Procedure 2; Claim Procedure 3; Claim Procedure 4; Claim Procedure 5; Claim Procedure 6; Claim HCPCS 1; Claim HCPCS 2; Claim HCPCS 3; Claim HCPCS 4; Claim HCPCS 5; Claim HCPCS 6; Claim HCPCS 7; Claim HCPCS 8; Claim HCPCS 9; Claim HCPCS 10.
